description: Update a Tripsy trip by id. If updating cover_image_url, the MCP server validates direct Unsplash URL shape; if the client also has external URL access, check that the image URL is reachable and not a 404 before saving it. Safety: Closed-world: operates within the authenticated user's Tripsy account and accessible trips. Destructive: overwrites supplied fields on an existing Tripsy record; previous values are not automatically preserved or restored by this tool.
